exposure: type of basal insulin (Neutral Protamine Hagedorn (NPH))
type of basal insulin (continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion (CSII))
cohort: The study included 1534 pregnant women with type 1 diabetes, carrying singleton pregnancies, who delivered between 2002-2010 and consistently used the same basal and prandial insulin from before pregnancy until delivery.
finding: CSII was independently associated with lower insulin doses, higher HbA1c in all trimesters, and increased rates of miscarriage, preterm birth, and neonatal hypoglycemia, while glargine was linked to a higher risk of preterm birth and SGA infants.
